The Assessor's Office analyzed your assessment appeal and supporting documentation and determined the assessed
valuation should remain as originally proposed for the following reasons:
This is a result of a market analysis of your property as well as an analysis of comparable properties.
You do not need to take further action at this time. Your appeal result(s) and assessment values can be found in the
back page of this letter. This information can also be found on our website at www.cookcountyassessor.com by
searching your property identification number (PIN) or address.
If you are dissatisfied with the results of your appeal, you may file an appeal of your assessment at the Cook County
Board of Review. The Board of Review is located in the County Building, 118 N. Clark St., Room 601, Chicago, IL
60602. For the Board's appeal deadline and additional information about their appeal process, contact the Board of
Review at (312) 603-5542 or visit www.cookcountyboardofreview.com.
